name: p2-action-model-mainline
title: sub: p2-action-model-mainline
creator: codex
subtasks: S1 action-protocol: ActionCapability.PUBLISH + publish payload + key-level three-state serializer + not-wired 501
S2 policy-engine: deterministic fail-closed verdict between plan_action and resolve_action
S3 action-executor: PUBLISH via Tool Gateway, idempotency key wired, RetryPolicy unlocked
S4 mainline: PublisherAgent emits PublishIntent, xhs.publish orphan disappears, gate assertion updated in same PR
notes: S3 landed on feat/p2a-s3-action-executor (base ab9c10ac). Scope: PUBLISH finally produces an external effect -- new module creator_agent/execution.py (payload builder, gateway->platform vocabulary, two injectable seams whose defaults ARE the production implementations), execute_action executes publish, and the account_id is threaded all the way into services.xhs_publisher so the account-keyed publish cooldown gains a production writer (this CLOSES the pre-existing defect S2 pinned). ActionCapabilityNotWiredError is no longer raised anywhere. thread_id joined the publish payload with an ASYMMETRIC rule: required when creating an intent, optional when reading a stored row (rows written before S3 have none and must stay readable; they are then refused at execution, not crashed on). REVISION of the S2 handoff: RetryPolicy is NOT unlocked. The idempotency key satisfies ToolSpec's precondition but cannot answer the question a retry needs -- 'did the submit already go out?' A gateway timeout cancels the call mid-submit in the browser flow, so a caller cannot tell a pre-submit failure from a lost answer, and retrying the latter double-posts. max_attempts stays 1 until the executor can reconcile before re-submitting (durable retry, P2b); the ticket's 'RetryPolicy unlocked' wording is amended. Gates: pytest 3144 passed/3 skipped (S2 3115 + 29 = exactly the new cases: 20 new file + 6 tool layer + 3 payload -> zero existing cases touched), ruff 499 files, mypy 202 files clean, P1b baseline drift within threshold, tool_runtime_gate OK (xhs.publish still the only orphan by design until S4). Mutation self-check 9/9 killed, each from original bytes by a named assertion; independent spot-check 3/3 (M2/M4/M6) with the failure reason verified, not just the exit code. Two findings: (a) the near-miss bug -- DomainOutcome's payload is **kwargs, not a keyword, so DomainOutcome(reason, payload=dict(result)) buries every platform verdict one level down and silently degrades each into 'unexplained failure'; now pinned from the reader's side by asserting the WRONG shape; (b) NEW, recorded not decided: the 501 path (CreatorActionCapabilityNotWiredError) now has no producer, and execute_action's else-fallback would mint a receipt for an unwired capability -- either make the fallback refuse or delete the error type. Open question 3 (compute_publish_id vs ActionIntent.idempotency_key) still needs a written verdict.
